Performance is evaluated on both controlled synthetic data and long-term real interferograms from Laguna del Maule (Chile) and Campi Flegrei (Italy), with independent GNSS measurements used for validation. WaveDINO consistently outperforms competing models, improving agreement with GNSS measurements, and reducing mean GNSS misfit by approximately 3% and 19% at two sites, respectively, while surpassing weather-model-based corrections.

</details>


### [245] [An Open-Source Monitoring Framework for Data Exploration and Progress Tracking in Multi-Center Radiology Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16861)
*Markus Bujotzek,Jonas Scherer,Stefan Denner,Peter Neher,Benjamin Hamm,Lorenz Feineis,Uenal Akuenal,Andreas Bucher,Tobias Penzkofer,Klaus Maier-Hein*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于Grafana-Prometheus的轻量级开源监控架构，用于多中心研究的进度监控与数据探索，并在德国RACOON联盟的38家大学医院中成功部署验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多中心研究的协调依赖人工沟通和共享表格，易过时且低效，缺乏专门的监控方案来透明、实时地追踪研究进展。

Method: 提出基于Grafana-Prometheus栈的轻量级开源监控架构，从分布式站点收集聚合指标并通过可配置仪表盘可视化；集成到医学影像平台Kaapana中。

Result: 在德国RACOON联盟的38家大学医院成功部署，实现了隐私保护的数据探索和跨站点研究进度监控。

Conclusion: 该框架支持分布式研究活动的透明协调，有助于提高大规模多中心研究的管理效率；代码已公开。

Abstract: Multi-center studies are crucial for advancing medical and radiological research. Data exploration, collaboration discovery, and study progress monitoring are essential for maximizing their potential. However, in practice these processes often rely on manual communication and shared tables, which quickly become outdated and hinder efficient coordination in large distributed studies. This highlights the need for dedicated monitoring solutions that provide transparent and up-to-date insights into study progress. We propose a lightweight, open-source monitoring architecture for multi-center studies based on the widely used Grafana-Prometheus stack. The framework collects aggregated monitoring metrics from distributed study sites and visualizes them through configurable dashboards. As a real-world deployment example, the framework is integrated into the medical imaging platform Kaapana and evaluated within a large multi-center research network. By deploying our solution within the Germany-wide RACOON consortium, we demonstrate its ability to enable privacy-preserving data exploration and study progress monitoring across all 38 German university clinics. The monitoring framework supports transparent coordination of distributed research activities and can facilitate more efficient management of large-scale multi-center studies. The source code and Kaapana integration are publicly available at https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/study-monitoring-kaapana.

</details>


### [246] [Redirecting the Flow: Image Customization through Attention Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16866)
*Jie Li,Suorong Yang,Jian Zhao,Furao Shen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CustomShift，一种基于条件注意力分布偏移的双分支架构，用于解决主体驱动图像定制中的效率、特征对齐和无关信息干扰问题，在DreamBooth和Custom101基准上超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法（测试时微调、编码器方法、共享注意力空间中的token竞争）存在效率低、参考特征与生成过程对齐不佳、无关信息干扰等问题。

Method: 将定制任务建模为引入参考图像导致的分布偏移，基于最大熵理论推导出条件注意力分布偏移公式；提出CustomShift，包含Reference-Alignment Branch（利用参考图像与主体名称的自注意力实现逐层对齐）和Cross-Guidance Branch（融合文本与参考线索指导生成），基于Stable Diffusion 3构建。

Result: 在DreamBooth和Custom101基准上，该方法一致优于现有最先进方法，在语义保真度和主体一致性之间取得更优平衡。

Conclusion: CustomShift通过理论驱动的条件注意力分布偏移公式，有效解决了现有方法的效率和对齐问题，实现了更优的主体驱动图像定制性能。

Abstract: Subject-driven image customization aims to generate images that not only follow textual instructions but also preserve the identity of a given reference subject. Existing approaches, including test-time fine-tuning, encoder-based methods, and token competition in shared attention spaces, suffer from limited efficiency, misalignment between extracted reference features and the generative process, and interference from irrelevant information. To address these limitations, we formulate the customization task as a distribution shift induced by incorporating reference images into text-to-image generation, and derive a Conditional Attention Distribution Shift formulation grounded in maximum entropy theory. Building on this formulation, we propose CustomShift, a dual-branch architecture based on Stable Diffusion 3. The Reference-Alignment Branch leverages self-attention between reference images and subject names to achieve layer-wise alignment with latent representations, while the Cross-Guidance Branch integrates textual and reference cues to guide generation. Experiments on the DreamBooth and Custom101 benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, achieving a better balance between semantic fidelity and subject consistency.

</details>


### [247] [Latent Space Reinforcement Learning for Inverse Material Estimation in Food Fracture Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16870)
*Adrian Ramlal,Yuhao Chen,John S. Zelek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对非可微连续介质损伤力学模拟器中食品材料的断裂行为参数估计逆问题，以剥橙子为测试案例，比较了CMA-ES（进化优化）和PPO（强化学习）两种方法。训练了一个目标条件的PPO策略，在归一化流潜空间中实现从目标断裂行为描述到材料参数的单次前向映射（约10ms），恢复率0.642，经CMA-ES预热扩展后提升至0.828。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 食品材料的视觉真实模拟需要精确的材料参数，但这些参数难以直接测量，且同一食品不同区域参数各异。现有方法无法高效解决非可微模拟器中的参数逆估计问题，亟需一个无需针对每个目标重新训练的通用逆映射系统。

Method: 1) 以剥橙子为案例，构建9维原始参数空间和2个4维学习潜空间；2) 训练神经网络代理模型替代2,000次正向模拟；3) 比较CMA-ES（无梯度进化优化）与PPO（强化学习）的性能；4) 训练目标条件PPO策略，在归一化流潜空间中学习通用逆映射；5) 提出预热扩展策略，用策略输出初始化CMA-ES精调。

Result: 目标条件PPO策略在归一化流潜空间中以单次前向（约10ms，8次代理评估）实现0.642的恢复率，比原始参数空间提升23%。经CMA-ES预热扩展（540次评估）后恢复率提升至0.828。

Conclusion: 本研究为食品物理逆向工程提供了实用框架，证明了目标条件强化学习结合潜空间表示能高效解决非可微模拟器中的参数逆估计问题，为未来从视频观测中实现视觉驱动的材料识别奠定了基础。

Abstract: Realistic visual simulation of food manipulation requires accurate material parameters, yet these are difficult to measure directly and vary across the heterogeneous regions of a single food item. We address the inverse problem of estimating material parameters from a target description of fracture behavior in a non-differentiable continuum damage mechanics simulator. Using orange peeling as a test case, we train a neural surrogate on 2,000 forward simulations and compare Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES, a gradient-free evolutionary optimizer) with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm) across the original 9-dimensional parameter space and two learned 4-dimensional latent representations. Since different oranges have different material properties, a practical inverse system must handle arbitrary targets without retraining. We train a goal-conditioned PPO policy that learns a general inverse mapping: given any target description of peeling behavior, the policy produces a material parameter estimate in a single forward pass (8 surrogate evaluations, approximately 10ms). Operating in a normalizing flow latent space with a shared surrogate evaluator, the goal-conditioned policy achieves 0.642 actual recovery when validated through the simulator, outperforming the original parameter space by 23%. A warm-start extension that initializes CMA-ES refinement from the policy's output further improves recovery to 0.828 with 540 evaluations. These findings provide a practical framework for inverse food physics and lay groundwork for vision-driven material identification from video observations of food manipulation.

</details>


### [248] [Simulation-Based Multi-Fillet Evaluation of Woody Breast Poultry Fillets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16951)
*Chirantan Sen Mukherjee,Seung-Chul Yoon,William J. Beksi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于俯视摄像头的多鸡胸肉木质化（WB）检测架构，通过数字孪生和物理仿真生成数据集，利用2D形状变形分数替代传统侧视系统，实现多肉块同时检测，解决了现有方法吞吐量不足的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有侧视WB检测系统虽精度高，但只能单条检测，形成商在线瓶颈，亟需可同时处理多条鸡胸肉的高通量检测方案。

Method: 1）构建工业传送带的数字孪生；2）合成3D鸡胸肉网格数据集并用物理引擎模拟粘弹性弯曲动力学；3）从俯视视角提取连续的2D形状变形分数，捕捉肉块经过滚轮边缘时的轮廓变化。

Result: 俯视形状变形分数能有效捕捉鸡胸肉弯曲时的轮廓变化，为多肉块同时检测提供了鲁棒且可扩展的替代方案。

Conclusion: 俯视成像系统是侧视系统在同时多肉块WB评估方面的有效替代方案，能克服现有技术的吞吐量瓶颈。

Abstract: Woody breast (WB) is a myopathy in modern broiler chickens that causes the breast muscle to become unusually stiff and fibrous, leading to decreased meat quality and significant economic losses. State-of-the-art automated WB detection relies on a side-view imaging system to analyze the bending behavior of a single fillet as it falls off a conveyor belt. While highly accurate, this approach is constrained by its single-fillet field of view, creating throughput bottlenecks on commercial processing lines. In this paper, we address this limitation via a novel multi-fillet detection architecture utilizing a top-down camera configuration. To validate our approach, we first develop a high-fidelity digital twin of an industrial conveyor system. Next, we synthesize a diverse dataset of 3D fillet meshes and model their viscoelastic bending dynamics using a physics-based simulation engine. Lastly, a continuous 2D shape deformation score is extracted from the top-down perspective as the simulated fillets traverse the roller precipice. Experimental results demonstrate that the top-down shape score effectively captures the contour changes of the fillets as it bends, providing a robust and scalable alternative to a side-view imaging system for simultaneous multi-fillet WB evaluation.

</details>


### [249] [SurroundNEXO: Ego-Centric Metric Bridging for Spatially Consistent Geometry in Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16960)
*Shuai Yuan,Runxi Tang,Yuzhou Ji,Fudong Ge,Hanshi Wang,Yifei Wang,Xianming Zeng,Jianyun Xu,Xingliang Liu,Yanfeng Wang,Zhipeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SurroundNEXO提出了一种基于自车几何而非密集视觉对应的低重叠多相机度量深度框架，通过Ego-Ray位置编码、稀疏激光雷达度量锚点和渐进式特征交互，显著提升了跨视角一致性和度量深度预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶多相机深度预测方法依赖传统多视图几何中的密集视觉对应关系，但车载环视相机间视觉重叠度低，导致对应关系不可靠，限制了跨视图推理的性能。

Method: （1）Ego-Ray位置编码：将图像token赋予全局可比较的自车坐标系视线方向；（2）稀疏激光雷达度量锚点：利用稀疏LiDAR测量传递绝对尺度信息；（3）渐进式特征交互：从视图局部建模，到分解的时空推理，再到全局整合，逐步扩大特征交互范围。

Result: 在NuScenes、Waymo和DDAD基准上，单视图误差降低33.2%，跨视图一致性提升10.5%，度量重建质量提升25.6%；在极稀疏深度提示下保持鲁棒，并展现出对未见相机布局的强零样本泛化能力。

Conclusion: SurroundNEXO通过几何先验引导而非密集视觉对应，有效解决了低重叠多相机深度估计问题，为自动驾驶系统提供了一种更鲁棒、一致且可泛化的度量3D感知方案。

Abstract: Modern autonomous driving depends on accurate metric 3D understanding for perception, reconstruction, and planning, which in turn requires reliable multi-camera depth prediction. However, the outward-facing nature of vehicle-mounted surround-view camera rigs inherently limits visual overlap across views, challenging the correspondence-based assumptions that underpin conventional multi-view geometry. To bridge this gap, we present SurroundNEXO, named after the Spanish word nexo for a geometric link, a low-overlap multi-camera metric depth framework that grounds cross-view reasoning in ego-centric geometry rather than dense visual correspondences. Instead of directly enforcing early global fusion, SurroundNEXO first assigns image tokens globally comparable ego-frame viewing directions through Ego-Ray Positional Encoding, then uses sparse LiDAR measurements as metric anchors to propagate absolute scale cues, and finally expands feature interaction progressively from view-local modeling to decomposed spatio-temporal reasoning and global integration. This design enables metric-scale depth prediction with improved spatial consistency across weakly overlapping cameras. Across low-overlap autonomous driving benchmarks, including NuScenes, Waymo and DDAD, SurroundNEXO reduces single-view error by 33.2%, improves cross-view consistency by 10.5%, and enhances metric reconstruction quality by 25.6% compared with SOTA methods. It further remains robust under extremely sparse depth prompts and exhibits strong zero-shot generalization to unseen camera layouts.

</details>


### [250] [A Multi-Center Benchmark for Abdominal Disease Diagnosis and Report Generation from Non-Contrast CT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16991)
*Mariam Elbakry,Aliaa Sayed Sheha,Salma Hassan Tantawy,Aya Yassin,Concetto Spampinato,Karim Lekadir,Xiaomeng Li,Marawan Elbatel*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个多中心基准，用于从单期非增强CT（NCCT）合成增强发现并生成腹部放射学报告，旨在减少对比剂风险和工作负担。内部队列平均多器官AUC达69.1%，外部队列达63.1%，证明了NCCT保留诊断信号的潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多期增强CT虽广泛用于腹部病变表征，但存在对比剂肾病风险、采集负担高、放射科医生工作量大等问题。现有方法依赖增强CT，而NCCT作为更安全、低成本的替代方案，其诊断潜力未被充分挖掘。

Method: 构建大规模配对NCCT-CECT数据集及对比增强放射学报告（来自两个中心）；制定统一评估协议；对五种深度学习架构（胸部专用、腹部专用、通用多模态）进行基准测试。

Result: 内部队列平均多器官AUC为69.1%，外部队列为63.1%。NCCT保留了诊断信号，能够合成对比增强发现并生成报告。

Conclusion: NCCT有望替代增强CT实现更安全、资源高效的腹部成像。公开数据集和基准可推动无对比剂腹部影像工作流的研究。

Abstract: Multiphasic contrast-enhanced CT (CECT) is widely used for abdominal lesion characterization, yet it carries inherent risks of contrast-induced nephropathy, escalates acquisition burden, and heavily contributes to radiologist workload. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel multi-center benchmark for multi-organ abdominal disease diagnosis and automated radiology report generation, which learns to synthesize contrast-enhanced findings from single-phase non-contrast CT (NCCT). To support this, we curated a large-scale dataset of paired NCCT-CECT studies and their corresponding contrast-enhanced radiology reports from two centers, partitioned into internal sets and an external validation cohort. Under a unified evaluation protocol, we benchmarked five contemporary deep learning architectures encompassing chest-specific, abdomen-specific, and general-purpose multimodal domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NCCT retains diagnostic signals, achieving an average multi-organ AUC of 69.1% on the internal cohort and 63.1% on the external cohort, respectively. By releasing this dataset and standardized benchmark publicly, this study aims to catalyze future research into safer, resource-efficient, and globally accessible contrast-free abdominal imaging workflows. Code is available at: https://github.com/xmed-lab/TriALS-Report.

</details>


### [251] [DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16993)
*DreamX Team,Yancheng Bai,Rui Chen,Xiangxiang Chu,Rujing Dang,Hao Dou,Bingjie Gao,Qiwen Gu,Siyu Hong,Jiachen Lei,Geng Li,Jifan Li,Ruimin Lin,Qingfeng Shi,Bingze Song,Lei Sun,Jing Tang,Ruitian Tian,Jun Wang,Jiahong Wu,Pengfei Zhang,Shen Zhang,Jiashu Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DreamX-World 1.0 是一个通用交互式文图到视频世界模型，支持可控长时程生成、相机导航、场景重访和事件控制，在多种视觉风格下均有效，通过因果强制、蒸馏训练、记忆检索和强化学习等技术，实现了16FPS的推理速度和领先的综合评分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型在长时程生成中缺乏可控性、相机控制、场景一致性和交互能力，难以作为通用的世界模型使用。

Method: 提出了E-PRoPE相机编码、因果强制自回归转换、长展开训练、Memory-Conditioned Scene Persistence记忆检索、残差循环利用、Event Instruction Tuning事件指令微调以及强化学习对齐。数据引擎融合了Unreal Engine渲染、游戏录制和真实视频。

Result: 在5秒基础评测中，相机控制得分73.75，综合得分84.76，超过HY-WorldPlay 1.5（80.79）和LingBot-World（80.45）；在8张RTX 5090上达到16FPS。

Conclusion: DreamX-World 1.0 通过多维技术创新，在长时程、高可控的视频世界建模中取得了领先性能，验证了自回归蒸馏训练与记忆增强等策略在视频生成中的有效性。

Abstract: DreamX-World 1.0 is a general-purpose interactive text/image-to-video world model for controllable long-horizon generation. It supports camera navigation, revisits to previously observed regions, and promptable events across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized domains. Our data engine combines camera-accurate Unreal Engine rendering, action-rich gameplay recordings, and real-world videos with recovered camera geometry. For camera control, we introduce E-PRoPE, a lightweight variant of projective positional encoding that retains PRoPE's projective camera geometry while applying camera-aware attention to spatially reduced tokens. We convert a bidirectional video generator into a few-step autoregressive world model using causal forcing, DMD-style distillation, and long-rollout training. Training on self-generated long-horizon contexts exposes the model to its own generated history and reduces the style and color drift that accumulates across autoregressive chunks. Memory-Conditioned Scene Persistence retrieves earlier views through camera-geometry-based retrieval, while residual recycling makes the conditioning path less sensitive to imperfect memory latents. Event Instruction Tuning adds composable event control, and reinforcement learning alignment recovers camera control and visual quality after distillation. With mixed-precision DiT execution, residual reuse, 75\%-pruned VAE decoding, and asynchronous pipeline parallelism, DreamX-World 1.0 reaches up to 16\,FPS on eight RTX\,5090 GPUs. On our 5-second basic evaluation, DreamX-World 1.0 achieves a camera-control score of 73.75 and an overall score of 84.76, outperforming HY-WorldPlay 1.5 and LingBot-World in overall score, which achieve 80.79 and 80.45, respectively.

</details>


### [252] [MeshLoom: Feed-Forward Non-Rigid Registration of Mesh Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17027)
*Jianqi Chen,Jiraphon Yenphraphai,Xiangjun Tang,Sergey Tulyakov,Chaoyang Wang,Peter Wonka,Rameen Abdal*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MeshLoom是一种前馈配准网络，通过拓扑感知的编码器-解码器设计，直接重建网格序列中的顶点变形，无需逐实例优化，可在数秒内配准多个网格，并在非刚性配准、运动插值和网格变形上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非刚性配准方法受限于逐实例优化成本高、物体类别狭窄、仅支持成对输入或仅输出中间结果，缺乏高效、通用、端到端的解决方案。

Method: 1) 拓扑感知点表示：将锚网格的拓扑编码到逐顶点特征中，区分欧氏近但测地远的点；2) 多模态编码器：融合锚网格表示、形状潜码和图像特征，压缩为紧凑的全局运动嵌入；3) 轻量解码器：通过查询全局嵌入与锚网格点表示，逐顶点恢复目标时刻的变形。

Result: 在多种运动类型和物体类别上，MeshLoom在非刚性配准任务上取得了SOTA结果，并且能自然扩展到运动插值和网格变形。

Conclusion: MeshLoom通过全局嵌入-查询范式，实现了高效、类别通用的非刚性配准，并具备运动插值等多任务扩展能力。

Abstract: We present MeshLoom, a feed-forward registration network that directly reconstructs vertex deformations across mesh sequences. Our approach advances non-rigid registration beyond existing models, which are typically constrained by costly per-instance optimization, narrow object categories, pairwise-only inputs, or merely intermediate outputs. The network is simple and efficient, registering multiple meshes within seconds. At its core lies a topology-aware encoder--decoder design. Specifically, we first introduce a topology-aware point representation that encodes the anchor (reference) mesh's topology into its per-vertex features. This representation strengthens the network's understanding of the anchor-mesh geometry and disambiguates points that are Euclidean-close yet geodesically distant. We then propose a multi-modal encoder that fuses this anchor-mesh representation with complementary cues from each frame, such as shape latents and image features. These multi-source signals are compressed into a compact global motion embedding that captures dense inter-frame correspondence. A lightweight decoder then queries this global embedding with the anchor-mesh point representation, retrieving per-vertex deformations at target timestamps. Through extensive experiments across diverse motions and object categories, we show that MeshLoom achieves state-of-the-art results on non-rigid registration. In addition, we find that our global embedding-then-query paradigm naturally enables the network to generate deformations at intermediate timestamps, which extends MeshLoom to motion interpolation and mesh morphing. Project page: https://meshloom.github.io/ .

</details>


### [253] [Qwen-RobotWorld Technical Report: Unifying Embodied World Modeling through Language-Conditioned Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17030)
*Jie Zhang,Xiaoyue Chen,Anzhe Chen,Chenxu Lv,Deqing Li,Gengze Zhou,Hang Yin,Haoqi Yuan,Haoyang Li,Jiahao Li,Jiazhao Zhang,Jingren Zhou,Kaiyuan Gao,Kun Yan,Lihan Jiang,Ningyuan Tang,Pei Lin,Qihang Peng,Shengming Yin,Tianhe Wu,Tianyi Yan,Xiao Xu,Yan Shu,Yanran Zhang,Ye Wang,Yi Wang,Yilei Chen,Yixian Xu,Yiyang Huang,Yuxiang Chen,Zekai Zhang,Zhendong Wang,Zhixing Lei,Zhixuan Liang,Zihao Liu,Zikai Zhou,Xiong-Hui Chen,Chenfei Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Qwen-RobotWorld是一个语言条件化的视频世界模型，通过自然语言作为统一动作接口，预测机器人操作、自动驾驶、室内导航和人机迁移等场景的未来视觉轨迹。模型采用双流MMDiT架构、86亿帧的动作-语言语料库以及两阶段渐进训练策略，在多个基准测试中达到领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型多局限于单一任务或场景，缺乏统一的动作接口和跨具身形态的泛化能力。作者希望通过自然语言统一不同具身智能任务的表示，实现一个可扩展、可迁移的视频世界模型。

Method: 三部分组成：1) Double-Stream MMDiT with MLLM Action Encoding：60层双流扩散Transformer，通过逐层联合注意力耦合Qwen2.5-VL语义与视频VAE潜变量；2) Embodied World Knowledge (EWK)：86亿帧、涵盖20+具身形态和500+动作类别的视频-文本语料库；3) General+Expert Progressive Curriculum：两阶段训练策略，先学习通用视觉先验，再在统一语言接口下注入具身专用知识。

Result: 在EWMBench和DreamGen Bench上排名第一，在WorldModelBench和PBench上超越所有开源模型。在RoboTwin-IF基准上的零样本分析进一步验证了强大的泛化能力和多视角一致性。

Conclusion: Qwen-RobotWorld验证了以语言为统一接口构建跨具身形态视频世界模型的可行性，为合成数据生成、策略评估和语言引导规划等应用提供了有效的基础架构。

Abstract: We introduce Qwen-RobotWorld, a language-conditioned video world model for embodied intelligence. With natural language as a unified action interface, it predicts physically grounded future visual trajectories from current observations across robotic manipulation, autonomous driving, indoor navigation, and human-to-robot transfer. This unified formulation provides three promising application directions: synthetic data generation for policy training augmentation, scalable virtual environments for policy evaluation, and language-guided planning signals for downstream robot control. This is achieved through a three-part design: a) Double-Stream MMDiT with MLLM Action Encoding, where a 60-layer double-stream diffusion transformer couples frozen Qwen2.5-VL semantics with video-VAE latents through layer-wise joint attention; b) Embodied World Knowledge (EWK), an 8.6M video-text corpus (200M+ frames) with action-language mapping over 20+ embodiments and 500+ action categories; and c) General+Expert Progressive Curriculum, a two-stage training strategy that first learns general visual priors and then injects embodied specialization under a shared language interface. Extensive results show strong competitiveness: ranks 1st overall on EWMBench and DreamGen Bench, outperforms all open-source models on WorldModelBench and PBench. Additional zero-shot analyses on RoboTwin-IF benchmark further support robust generalization and multi-view consistency.

</details>


### [254] [BRDFusion: Physics Meets Generation for Urban Scene Inverse Rendering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17049)
*Yi-Ruei Liu,Jie-Ying Lee,Zheng-Hui Huang,Yu-Lun Liu,Chih-Hao Lin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BRDFusion是一个统一框架，结合物理渲染模型与生成模型，实现城市场景的逆向渲染，在保持可控性的同时生成高质量视频，支持新视角重光照、夜间模拟和动态物体编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物理渲染方法存在重建和渲染伪影，而生成模型虽能生成真实视频但缺乏一致性和可控性。作者希望结合两者优势，实现既高质量又可控制的城市场景渲染。

Method: 提出BRDFusion框架，融合物理模型（恢复显式、一致的场景属性）与生成先验（缓解优化歧义）。在前向渲染中，物理模型提供基于场景配置的可控渲染，生成模型则用于去噪和修复伪影。

Result: 在真实和合成场景中均优于基线方法，支持新视角重光照、夜间模拟、动态物体插入/编辑等多种应用，能生成高质量视频。

Conclusion: 物理模型与生成模型的互补结合可以有效解决城市逆向渲染中的质量与可控性矛盾，为城市场景内容生成和自动驾驶仿真提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Inverse rendering of urban scenes from captured videos enables numerous applications, including content creation and autonomous driving simulation. Physically-based rendering methods follow and control lighting physics, but suffer from reconstruction and rendering artifacts. While generative models produce realistic videos, they offer limited consistency and controllability. We present BRDFusion, a unified framework that combines two complementary models for inverse and forward rendering. Specifically, BRDFusion recovers explicit, consistent scene properties with physical modeling and alleviates optimization ambiguity with generative priors. During forward rendering, the physical model provides controllable rendering from the scene configuration, and the generative model denoises and fixes artifacts. Therefore, our method produces high-quality videos while allowing precise control, outperforming baselines in real and synthetic scenes. Moreover, BRDFusion supports novel-view relighting, night simulation, and dynamic object insertion/editing. Project page: https://shigon255.github.io/brdfusion-page/

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [255] [Bayesian Optimization for Learning Nonlinear MPC in Autonomous Agent Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14763)
*Lorenzo Ortolani,Gabriel Voss,Gabriele Beltrami,Francesco Dorati,Tommaso Felice Banfi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了一个无地图框架，将反应式滚动时域规划与非线性MPC控制集成，结合贝叶斯优化进行参数调优，在Unitree Go2四足机器人上实现了最高90%的导航成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决动态未知环境中移动机器人的实时自主导航难题，传统地图依赖方法在复杂动态场景下适应性差，且控制器参数对性能敏感、人工调参困难。

Method: 1) LiDAR高斯占据表示构建环境；2) A*搜索生成无碰撞轨迹；3) CasADi/IPOPT MPC跟踪轨迹，含sigmoid障碍屏障函数；4) 离线TPE贝叶斯优化寻找近优控制器参数；5) 高斯过程代理分析参数敏感性。

Result: 模拟中调优的参数可直接迁移至实物机器人，无需额外调参；实物部署导航成功率达90.0%；模拟环境中评估指标平均提升38.9%。

Conclusion: 提出了一种机器人无关的无地图导航框架，通过离线贝叶斯优化有效解决了参数敏感性问题，且仿真到实物的迁移性良好，验证了框架的实用性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Real-time autonomous navigation in dynamic, unknown environments remains a fundamental challenge for mobile robotics. We propose a map-free framework that tightly integrates reactive rolling-horizon planning with nonlinear Model Predictive Control (MPC). At each control cycle, a LiDAR-based Gaussian occupancy representation is constructed and used to generate collision-free trajectories via A* search, which are then tracked by a CasADi/IPOPT MPC formulation incorporating a smooth sigmoid obstacle barrier. To improve robustness to parameter sensitivity, we adopt an offline Bayesian optimization scheme based on Tree-structured Parzen Estimators (TPE), which identifies near-optimal controller parameters with respect to a composite navigation objective. In addition, a Gaussian Process surrogate is used to analyze parameter sensitivity and provide insight into the optimization landscape.
  The proposed framework is robot-agnostic and is evaluated on the Unitree Go2 quadruped in simulation using Gazebo, followed by deployment on the physical robot. Experimental results show that parameters tuned in simulation transfer effectively to hardware, maintaining comparable performance without additional tuning. The full system achieves up to a 90.0\% navigation success rate when deployed, along with a 38.9\% average improvement in the evaluation metrics across simulated environments.

</details>


### [256] [Synthetic-to-Real Pipeline for Safe Landing Zone Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14767)
*Shrikant Banerjee,Reza Faieghi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套面向无人机自主着陆的感知与数据生成流水线，利用程序化合成数据引擎生成逼真城市环境并自动标注，在此基础上微调基于Transformer的OneFormer架构实现语义分割，并结合欧几里得距离变换与动态推理逻辑确定安全着陆区域。实验证明该方法无需人工标注即可在未知环境中实现可靠的着陆点检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机向高自主性方向发展时，在非协作、非结构化环境中实现无辅助回收至关重要。安全自主着陆需要高保真语义分辨率以区分可通行地形与危险障碍，但标注航拍数据集的稀缺严重阻碍了开发进程。

Method: 1) 提出程序化合成数据引擎，通过域随机化生成逼真城市环境并自动生成语义标注；2) 基于此合成数据微调Transformer架构的OneFormer模型，利用多头自注意力机制捕获全局上下文；3) 设计确定性着陆模块，结合欧几里得距离变换(EDT)与动态推理逻辑，识别最大内接安全着陆区域，并保持严格的障碍物缓冲距离。

Result: 定量评估：在UAVid数据集上展示了鲁棒的语义分割性能；定性验证：在真实无人机视频上确认了系统能够在未见环境中识别无碰撞着陆点。

Conclusion: 高保真程序化仿真能够消除对人工标注的需求，同时为无人机自主回收提供鲁棒、可边缘部署的态势感知能力。

Abstract: As Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) transition toward higher levels of autonomy, the ability to perform unassisted recovery in non-cooperative, unstructured environments becomes critical. Achieving safe autonomous landing requires high-fidelity semantic resolution to distinguish navigable terrain from hazardous obstacles, yet development is often hindered by the scarcity of annotated aerial datasets. This work proposes a comprehensive perception and data generation pipeline designed to bridge the sim-to-real gap for autonomous landing tasks. We introduce a procedural synthetic data engine that generates photorealistic urban environments with automated semantic annotations through domain randomization. A Transformer-based OneFormer architecture is fine-tuned exclusively on this synthetic data, leveraging multi-head self-attention mechanisms for global context resolution. To ensure operational safety, a deterministic landing module utilizes a Euclidean Distance Transform (EDT) and dynamic inference logic to identify the largest inscribed safe landing zones while maintaining strict clearance buffers around obstacles. Quantitative benchmarking against the UAVid dataset demonstrates robust semantic segmentation performance, while qualitative validation on real-world UAV footage confirms the system's ability to identify collision-free landing sites in unseen environments. Our results highlight the potential of high-fidelity procedural simulation to eliminate the need for manual annotation while providing robust, edge-deployable situational awareness for autonomous UAV recovery.

</details>


### [257] [Deep Learning-Based Lunar Crater Terrain Relative Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14776)
*Batu Candan,Simone Servadio*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合深度学习陨石坑检测器与扩展卡尔曼滤波的地形相对导航（TRN）算法，用于月球着陆器的精确位置估计，仿真表明即使初始误差达5公里，也能将导航误差降至数百米。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来月球着陆任务需要高精度位置估计，尤其是在地形特征稀疏的危险环境中，现有方法难以满足自主导航的精度和鲁棒性需求。

Method: 采用专为NASA陨石坑检测挑战设计的深度学习检测器从单目图像中提取陨石坑特征，通过匈牙利分配法匹配全局数据库中的陨石坑并用共识法剔除离群点，将匹配结果输入扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）进行位姿估计，结合高度辅助信息约束径向漂移。

Result: 仿真显示，即便初始位置偏差达5公里，TRN算法仍能恢复并实现误差降至数百米的导航精度。

Conclusion: 深度学习陨石坑检测器与EKF结合的TRN算法可有效提升月球着陆自主导航精度，但需注意图像分辨率与检测器训练集分布的匹配。

Abstract: Accurate position estimation is crucial for the successful implementation of future lunar landings using autonomous vehicles, especially in dangerous environments with sparse terrain features. In this paper, we propose a terrain relative navigation (TRN) algorithm combining our deep-learning crater detector, which was designed specifically for the NASA Crater Detection Challenge problem, and an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF). Our detector analyzes crater features from the monocular images acquired from orbit, and their matches with craters from a global database are identified via a Hungarian assignment approach followed by the consensus-based outliers removal method. The estimated measurements are then used to refine an EKF, where spacecraft pose estimation in the Lunar-Centered Lunar-Fixed (LCLF) frame of reference, augmented with altitude aiding information, constrains radial drift. The simulation results indicate that even if the spacecraft is off from its actual location up to 5 km, TRN could recover from this situation, achieving navigation error reduction to a few hundred meters. It should be noted that in order to maintain crater feature correspondences, it is important to match the image resolution and the scales within the scene to the detector training set distribution.

</details>


### [258] [Computing Smooth Geodesics under Two-Sided Curvature Bounds with Applications to Robotics and Image Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14794)
*Da Chen,Zhenjiang Li,Jean-Marie Mirebeau,Xuecheng Tai,Jinglin Zhang,Wei Zhang,Laurent D. Cohen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于曲率上下界约束的测地线模型，在Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman偏微分方程框架下，通过离散化哈密顿量实现高效求解，并将其应用于机器人路径规划和图像曲线结构追踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平面曲线的曲率是计算二阶最小路径的关键正则项，但现有方法难以处理曲率受任意上下界约束的路径追踪问题。本文旨在解决这一更具挑战性的计算物理与几何问题。

Method: 提出曲率有界测地线模型，基于Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman偏微分方程框架；对哈密顿量和HJB方程进行离散化处理，引入曲率上下界约束；设计高效数值求解器。

Result: 在机器人路径规划和图像曲线结构追踪应用中验证了模型的有效性，数值实验表明该模型能够鲁棒地找到满足曲率约束的满意路径。

Conclusion: 所提出的曲率有界测地线模型能够对最小路径施加强有力的几何控制，生成光滑且曲率受限的路径，是鲁棒且高效的路径规划与追踪工具。

Abstract: Curvature of planar curves serves as a key regularization term for computing second-order minimal paths, due to its tight relevance to desirable geometric properties such as smoothness, rigidity, and elasticity. In this paper, we tackle a more challenging problem in computational physics and geometry problem: tracking minimal paths whose curvature is constrained by arbitrary upper and lower bounds. For that purpose, we propose a new curvature-bounded geodesic model, developed under the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) partial differential equation (PDE) framework. It provides strong geometric control over minimal paths by enforcing curvature range constraints, whose paths are smooth and of bounded curvature limitation. We also present a discretization scheme for the Hamiltonian and the HJB PDE incorporating curvature bounds, allowing efficient solver for estimating numerical solutions to the model. Finally, we illustrate the capability of the proposed curvature-bounded geodesic model in applications of robot path planning and curvilinear structures tracking from images. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed curvature-bounded geodesic model serves as a powerful and robust tool for finding satisfactory paths.

</details>


### [259] [TacStyle: Personalizing Tactile Robot Policies using Structured Behavior Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14862)
*Kevin Robledo,Matías I. Torres Galaz,Kumar Dixhant Rai,Shelly Sara Ulman,Tasmia Tasrin,Heramb Nemlekar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出通过语言推理偏好行为而非直接生成，先学习结构化潜在空间组织用户偏好，再用基础模型解析该空间并选择对应值，从而在减少偏好标签的同时实现更精确的机器人行为适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有语言条件机器人策略虽能理解"做什么"，但难以精细控制"怎么做"（如力度大小），且收集偏好轨迹标签成本高，直接条件化标签也缺乏对连续行为范围的细粒度控制。

Method: 1) 学习结构化潜在空间，根据轨迹差异组织用户偏好；2) 给定偏好提示后，利用基础模型（foundation model）解析该潜在空间，选择能产生期望行为的潜在值。

Result: 在仿真和真实实验中，该方法相比语言条件策略，能以更少的偏好标签实现更精确的用户偏好适应。

Conclusion: 从直觉上结构化的潜在空间中选择机器人行为，能更精确地适应用户偏好，且显著减少对偏好标签的依赖。

Abstract: Robotic systems that assist humans should be capable of adapting their behaviors to individual user preferences. For instance, users may want a robot arm to adjust the amount of force it applies while folding their laundry or cleaning furniture. Natural language provides an intuitive way for humans to communicate such preferences. Recent progress in language-conditioned robot policies has shown that robots can successfully use language prompts to determine what task to perform. However, extending the same approach to realize how the task should be performed requires detailed labels describing the preferences or styles of trajectories in the task data. Not only is collecting such annotations challenging, but conditioning directly on these labels may also fail to provide fine-grained control over a continuous range of behaviors. For example, it can be difficult to convey the exact force that a robot must apply through abstract instructions like "apply a bit more pressure than before". Therefore, in this work, we propose using language to reason over preferred behaviors instead of directly generating them. We first learn a structured latent representation that organizes user preferences according to differences in the corresponding trajectories. Then, given a preference prompt, we use a foundation model to interpret this latent space and choose a value that produces the desired behavior. Through both simulation and real-world experiments, we show that selecting robot behaviors from an intuitively structured latent space enables more precise adaptation to user preferences while requiring significantly fewer preference labels than language-conditioned policies.

</details>


### [260] [VANDERER: Map-Free Exploration using Future-Aware and Visual-Curiosity-Guided Diffusion Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14879)
*Venkata Naren Devarakonda,Raktim Gautam Goswami,Prashanth Krishnamurthy,Farshad Khorrami*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出VANDERER框架，利用视觉好奇心模块（VCM）引导预训练扩散策略，使仅配备单目相机的智能体能够高效探索未知环境，平均比NoMaD多探索13.4%的区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统依赖占据地图的探索方法在仅使用单目相机等传感器受限的场景中难以生成准确的地图，需要更高效的探索策略。

Method: 通过视觉好奇心模块（VCM）预测动作结果，利用导航世界模型计算好奇心成本，以此引导扩散过程生成最大化探索的动作。

Result: 在多种模拟环境中，VANDERER一致优于基线方法，平均探索面积比NoMaD多13.4%，且发现视觉好奇心与几何好奇心在室外环境中存在直接相关性。

Conclusion: VANDERER能够有效利用视觉与几何好奇心的关系，在传感器受限条件下（仅单目相机）实现高效探索。

Abstract: Mobile agents require efficient exploration strategies to map unseen environments and autonomously plan tasks. Traditional methods rely on generating occupancy maps and optimizing the sequence in which unexplored regions are visited. However, in sensor-constrained settings, such as those limited to monocular cameras, generating accurate occupancy maps is challenging. To address this, we propose VANDERER, an exploration framework that leverages a Visual Curiosity Module (VCM) to guide pre-trained diffusion policies using only monocular image data. This curiosity module predicts the outcomes of proposed actions via a navigation world model and evaluates them through a curiosity cost. The cost then guides the diffusion process toward generating actions that maximize exploration. Evaluated across diverse simulated environments, VANDERER consistently outperforms established baselines, exploring an average of 13.4% more area than NoMaD. Our results reveal a direct correlation between visual and geometric curiosity in outdoor environments, demonstrating that VANDERER can effectively leverage this relationship for efficient exploration using sensor-constrained agents.

</details>


### [261] [DynaHMRC: Decentralized Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Collaboration for Dynamic Tasks with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14882)
*Wenhao Yu,Yu'ang Xie,Yifan Duan,Jie Peng,Guanting Ye,Ka-Veng Yuen,Yanyong Zhang,Jianmin Ji*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出DynaHMRC，一种去中心化的异构多机器人协作框架，通过将每个机器人建模为角色感知的LLM智能体，解决集中式LLM调度器在大规模动态场景下的可扩展性和适应性瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有集中式LLM调度器在团队规模和环境复杂度增加时扩展性差；任务建模未充分考虑动态变化；领域数据稀缺导致通用模型在专业任务中效率低下。

Method: 提出DynaHMRC去中心化框架，每个机器人作为角色感知的LLM智能体；设计四阶段闭环协作流程（自我描述、任务分配与领导竞标、领导者选举、反思执行）；构建含三类任务、四种动态变化和六种团队配置的基准测试；通过领域数据集微调预训练LLM。

Result: DynaHMRC在成功率上优于强基线，且动作和通信步数更少；在评估的团队规模内展现了良好的可扩展性趋势。

Conclusion: 去中心化的LLM智能体架构能有效缓解集中式瓶颈，提升动态异构多机器人系统的协作效率和可扩展性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide robots with richer task understanding and adaptability, making them promising for coordinating heterogeneous multi-robot systems in long-horizon tasks. Despite this potential, several challenges remain underexplored: (1) Centralized LLM schedulers scale poorly as team size and environmental complexity increase. A single model must process excessive contextual information, and long-context approximation may degrade reasoning quality; (2) Existing task formulations insufficiently consider dynamic settings, while robust adaptation to evolving task conditions is essential for real-world deployment; (3) Domain-specific data scarcity limits specialized robotic reasoning, making proprietary general-purpose models inefficient for expert tasks. To address these limitations, we propose DynaHMRC, a decentralized framework in which each robot acts as a role-aware LLM agent. This design mitigates the single-model context bottleneck and supports flexible collaboration across heterogeneous team configurations. DynaHMRC organizes collaboration as a four-stage closed-loop process: self-description, task allocation with leadership bidding, leader election, and reflective execution, supported by executable robot interfaces. We further develop a benchmark covering three task families, four dynamic variations, and six team configurations to systematically study dynamic task modeling. In addition, we conduct an empirical analysis to guide the construction of domain-specific expert datasets and fine-tune pretrained LLMs to improve specialized competence. Experiments show that DynaHMRC achieves higher success rates than strong baselines with fewer action and communication steps, while demonstrating promising scalability trends as team size grows within the evaluated settings.

</details>


### [262] [Multimodal Physiological Assessment of Contact-Rich Physical Human-Robot Interaction Under Varying Environmental Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14969)
*Yanyi Chen,Xi Wang,Min Deng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文通过多模态实验（温度、噪音、光照组合）研究接触式人机交互中操作者的生理负荷，发现任务性能保持稳定，但自主神经负荷（皮肤电导水平）随温度升高而增加，揭示了操作者通过增加生理努力来补偿环境压力的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统任务导向评估忽略了环境压力对操作者造成的生理负担，需要揭示客观性能之外的隐藏生理成本。

Method: 多模态实证研究：在18种温度、噪音、光照组合条件下进行接触追踪任务，同步记录EDA、sEMG、眼动追踪数据和主观舒适度评分，综合分析生理信号与执行数据。

Result: 任务性能在不同环境条件下保持稳定；自主神经负荷（SCL）随温度升高而增加；身体和认知负荷不受影响；主观舒适度与任务误差无显著关联。

Conclusion: 操作者通过增加生理努力（补偿机制）来维持任务表现，这启发开发生理感知控制架构以在非结构化环境中降低操作者负荷。

Abstract: Physical human-robot interaction (pHRI) in real-world settings exposes operators to fluctuating environmental conditions during contact-rich tasks. Traditional task-centric evaluations overlook the physiological burdens imposed by these stressors. Therefore, we conducted a multimodal empirical study involving contact-rich tracing tasks under 18 distinct combinations of temperature, acoustic noise, and illuminance. Synchronously, we recorded electrodermal activity (EDA), surface electromyography (sEMG), eye-tracking data, and subjective environmental comfort ratings. Evaluating these physiological signals alongside execution data revealed hidden physiological costs not captured by objective performance. The results revealed that task performance remained stable across all environmental conditions. Autonomic workload, indexed by tonic skin conductance level (SCL), increased with temperature, while physical and cognitive workload were unaffected. Perceived environmental comfort showed no significant association with tracing error or completion time. These findings reveal a compensatory mechanism where operators maintain consistent performance by increasing their physiological effort to suppress thermal discomfort. Such insight motivates the development of physiology-aware control architectures that leverage real-time physiological metrics to reduce operator workload in unstructured environments.

</details>


### [263] [Inference-time Policy Steering via Vision and Touch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.14981)
*Yilin Wu,Zilin Si,Zeynep Temel,Oliver Kroemer,Andrea Bajcsy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ViTaL提出了一种视觉-触觉推理时引导框架，通过双层优化实现接触丰富的机器人操作：高层视觉采样验证选择行为模式，低层触觉引导扩散编辑优化局部接触。在真实任务上成功率提升51%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时引导方法仅依赖视觉信息，但在接触丰富的操作任务中，视觉难以捕捉关键的局部交互信息（如接触力），导致验证不充分。

Method: 提出ViTaL框架，采用双层优化：高层通过视觉采样与验证进行长时程模式选择；低层通过触觉引导的扩散编辑优化短时程动作序列。学习视觉-触觉潜在世界模型，并设计语义对齐的视觉与触觉验证器，包括文本条件触觉奖励。

Result: 在三项真实接触丰富操作任务中，ViTaL相比基础策略成功率提升51%，相比单模态引导提升至少33%，相比朴素多模态融合提升至少20%。

Conclusion: 融合视觉与触觉的多模态推理时引导能显著提升接触丰富操作任务的成功率，双层优化结构有效解耦了全局行为选择与局部接触满足。

Abstract: Inference-time steering adapts pre-trained generative robot policies during deployment by verifying candidate actions before execution. While prior methods typically perform this verification only with visual observations, vision alone is often insufficient for contact-rich manipulation, where success depends on both global task progress and subtle local interactions such as contact force. We introduce ViTaL, a visuo-tactile inference-time steering framework that formulates multimodal guidance as a bi-level optimization problem. At the high level, visual sampling-and-verification performs long-horizon mode selection, deciding what behavior the robot should execute. At the low level, tactile-guided diffusion editing refines the selected action sequence over a shorter horizon to satisfy local contact requirements. To support outcome-based steering, ViTaL learns a visuo-tactile latent world model and employs semantically aligned visual and tactile verifiers, including a novel text-conditioned tactile reward that scores predicted tactile futures directly in latent space. Across three real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, ViTaL improves overall success by 51% over the base policy, outperforms unimodal steering by at least 33%, and exceeds naive multimodal fusion by at least 20%. Website: https://yilin-wu98.github.io/vital_website.

</details>


### [264] [LV-Calib: LiDAR-Camera Extrinsic Calibration with Boundary-Response Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15010)
*Sheng Hong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: LV-Calib 提出一种基于可打印平面靶标的 LiDAR-相机外参标定与 LiDAR 边界响应标定框架，通过视觉标记和圆形反射率边界提供联合观测，利用强度与几何约束迭代优化 LiDAR 特征点，并基于重投影一致性与特征对齐进行加权外参优化，最后标定 LiDAR 的边界响应特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LiDAR-相机标定方法在利用平面靶标时，未能有效处理 LiDAR 在黑白反射率边界处因有限光束足迹和混合强度返回导致的特征点展宽与畸变，影响标定精度。

Method: 1) 使用可打印平面靶标，视觉侧用 fiducial 标记提供图像测量，LiDAR 侧用圆形反射率边界提供结构特征点；2) 自动裁剪背景点、估计靶标平面，基于强度与几何约束迭代精化 LiDAR 3D 特征点；3) 构建加权重投影一致性的外参优化，LiDAR 特征残差由精化置信度加权；4) 利用外参和提取的过渡带，通过估计边界重叠样本的俯仰-偏航-距离残差统计来标定 LiDAR 边界响应。

Result: 在印刷板标定数据上实现了亚像素级重投影精度、毫米级 LiDAR 特征一致性，并且提升了里程计性能。

Conclusion: LV-Calib 有效解决了 LiDAR 反射率边界处的特征点畸变问题，提供了高精度的外参和边界响应标定方案，且代码和数据将开源。

Abstract: We present LV-Calib, a calibration framework for LiDAR-camera extrinsic estimation and LiDAR boundary-response calibration using a printable planar target. The target serves as a shared observation carrier: visual fiducials provide indexed image measurements, while circular reflectivity boundaries provide LiDAR-observable structural feature points. Instead of directly fitting boundary points as ideal geometric contours, LV-Calib automatically crops background points, estimates the target plane, and iteratively refines accurate LiDAR-side 3-D feature points from intensity and geometric constraints. The refinement explicitly handles the broadened and distorted transition band induced by finite beam footprint and mixed-intensity returns around black-white reflectivity discontinuities. Given these refined LiDAR features, we formulate a weighted reprojection-consistent extrinsic optimization with LiDAR feature alignment, where image observations are kept in the reprojection domain and LiDAR feature residuals are weighted by refinement confidence. Finally, using the estimated extrinsic and the extracted transition band, LV-Calib calibrates the LiDAR boundary response by estimating pitch-yaw-range residual statistics of boundary-overlap samples. Experiments on printed-board calibration data demonstrate sub-pixel reprojection accuracy, millimeter-level LiDAR feature consistency, and improved odometry performance. Code and calibration data will be released for reproducible evaluation.

</details>


### [265] [Steering Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Policies via Action Token Intervention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15021)
*Jason Chan,Jonathan C. Kao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Token Steering (TS)方法，通过在动作令牌空间直接干预，让用户无需重新训练即可引导VLA模型的机器人动作生成，在两个操作任务上将成功率从10.0%/16.7%提升至72.5%/93.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型生成的动作轨迹难以被非专业用户灵活控制，传统方法需要修改模型架构或重新训练。作者希望设计一种轻量级、推理时生效的方法，让用户能直观地影响机器人动作，同时保留VLA模型原有的灵巧性和任务先验。

Method: TS将用户的低维控制信号（如方向偏好）直接注入VLA模型的原生动作令牌表征空间，在推理时对自回归生成的动作令牌序列进行干预。用户输入用于引导而非覆盖预训练策略，因此无需训练或微调，且不改变VLM架构。

Result: 在两项家居操作任务中：1) 放置物品后关抽屉，成功率从10.0%提升至72.5%；2) 状态感知的物品互换，成功率从16.7%提升至93.8%。

Conclusion: TS提供了一种轻量级、直观的机器人基础模型操控方式，可改善消费级场景中的人机交互，并降低对用户身体控制能力的要求，提升可及性。

Abstract: We present Token Steering (TS), a method for dynamically steering trajectories generated by an autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) model through direct intervention in the action-token space. TS injects low-dimensional user inputs into the model's native action-token representation, allowing users to influence trajectory generation without modifying the underlying vision-language model (VLM) architecture. Because TS operates entirely at inference time, it requires no additional training or finetuning. User inputs guide rather than override the pretrained policy, allowing users to influence robot actions while preserving the dexterity, smoothness, and task priors learned by the VLA. We evaluate TS on two household manipulation tasks -- drawer closing after object placement and state-aware object swapping -- and improve success rates from 10.0% to 72.5% and from 16.7% to 93.8%, respectively. By enabling lightweight, intuitive steering over robot foundation models, our interface has the potential to improve human-robot interaction in consumer environments and broaden accessibility for individuals with limited physical control. Project website: https://jasontchan.github.io/token-steering/ .

</details>


### [266] [An Autonomous Subgram SMA-Based Swimmer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15028)
*Conor K. Trygstad,Francisco M. F. R. Gonçalves,Néstor O. Pérez-Arancibia*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Swima，一种900毫克重、受生物启发的微型游泳机器人，由两个10毫克的高功密度形状记忆合金致动器驱动，配备板载电源和计算能力，能在自主游泳超过18分钟，速度达22.4毫米/秒（0.56体长/秒），转向速率14°/秒，跟踪误差约6.5°。这是首个亚克级别的具备板载电源、驱动和计算的微型游泳机器人。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发首个亚克级别的具备板载电源、驱动和计算能力的自主微型游泳机器人，填补该领域空白。

Method: 采用两个10毫克高功密度形状记忆合金（SMA）驱动的致动器、定制PCB板载电路和11毫安时3.7伏507毫克单节锂离子电池实现自主供电与计算。

Result: 自主游泳超过18分钟，速度22.4毫米/秒（0.56体长/秒），转向率14°/秒，0度航向跟踪RMS误差约6.5°。

Conclusion: Swima是首个实现板载电源、驱动和计算的亚克级别微型游泳机器人，验证了该尺度下自主游泳的可行性。

Abstract: We present the Swima, a bioinspired 900-mg swimmer propelled by two 10-mg high-work-density (HWD) actuators driven by shape-memory alloy (SMA) wires. We integrated onboard power and computation by using a custom-built printed circuit board (PCB) and an 11-mAh 3.7-V 507-mg single-cell lithium-ion (Li-Ion) battery, which in conjunction enable autonomous swimming in excess of 18 min. The Swima can swim at speeds of up to 22.4 mm/s (0.56 Bl/s), achieves turning rates of up to 14°/s, and can follow 0-degree heading reference trajectories with root mean square (RMS) values of tracking errors of about 6.5° across multiple tests. This robot is the first subgram microswimmer with onboard power, actuation, and computation developed to date.

</details>


### [267] [Exact, Efficient, and Safe Occlusion-Aware Planning Using AH-Polyhedrons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15046)
*Long Kiu Chung,David Isele,Toktam Mohammadnejad,Faizan M. Tariq,Sangjae Bae,Shreyas Kousik,Jovin D'sa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: APRO提出了一种基于博弈论主动感知和AH-多面体可达性分析的遮挡感知规划框架，通过线性规划实现精确安全验证，在自主代客泊车场景中实现100%安全率与实时性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有遮挡感知方法要么缺乏形式化安全保证，要么假设智能体遵循道路结构，要么过于保守导致车辆被困。AVP场景中交通规则松散、遮挡频繁杂乱，需要一种既安全又非保守的规划方法。

Method: 将集合论安全条件重构为AH-多面体的并集，通过线性规划实现精确安全验证；集成到优化规划器或二分搜索方案中实现实时应用。

Result: 在仿真和硬件实验中，APRO在所有评估场景中实现100%安全率，同时保持实时性能，比现有具备形式化保证的方法更安全、更优决策。

Conclusion: APRO为自动驾驶遮挡感知规划提供了兼顾精确性和效率的解决方案，在安全性和最优性上超越现有方法。

Abstract: Safely handling occlusions is a fundamental challenge for autonomous mobile robots operating in dynamic environments. This issue is especially prominent in autonomous valet parking (AVP), where traffic rules are lax, occlusions are frequent and cluttered, and overly conservative behavior can leave vehicles stuck. However, existing methods either lack formal safety guarantees, assume agents follow road structures, or introduce conservatism, leaving occlusion-aware planning for AVP an open challenge. In this paper, we propose APRO (AH-Polyhedron Reachability for Occlusions), an exact and efficient occlusion-aware planning framework based on game-theoretic active perception and AH-polyhedron reachability analysis with AVP as our canonical use case. Our key insight is to reformulate set-based safety conditions in prior work as unions of AH-polyhedrons, enabling exact safety verification through linear programming (LP) without any additional conservatism in set computations or assumptions on road topology. We further show how the resulting safety conditions can be integrated into optimization-based planners or a bisection search scheme for real-time applications. We validate our method in simulation and hardware experiments, including data replay on a real-world parking lot dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that our method consistently achieved a 100% safety rate across all evaluated scenarios while maintaining real-time performance, resulting in safer and more optimal decisions than existing methods with formal safety guarantees.

</details>


### [268] [Design and Fabrication of a Spin Coater with In-Situ Optical Measurement for Soft Thin Films](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15068)
*Daniel Gliksberg,Jiajie Qiu,Jun Suzuki,Kamal Youcef-Toumi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种低成本的3D打印旋涂装置，集成了光学厚度测量系统，用于制造50-300微米厚的软弹性薄膜，厚度重复性在10微米以内，通过激光反射位移追踪实现非接触式测量，实验验证分辨率为3.6-3.7微米，重复性为13微米。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软弹性薄膜（如介电弹性体致动器）的厚度对性能影响显著，但传统接触式测量会导致变形，而光学测量设备昂贵复杂。因此需要一种低成本、非接触式、高精度的厚度测量旋涂系统。

Method: 设计并3D打印低成本旋涂机，集成象限光电探测器，通过激光束反射位移追踪实现原位厚度测量；采用有限元分析验证结构；使用校准金属垫片进行系统标定。

Result: 厚度分辨率达到3.6-3.7微米，最优测量重复性为13微米（95%置信区间）；制备的硅胶薄膜厚度与目标值偏差在9微米以内。

Conclusion: 证明了光学计量可以低成本和简易方式集成到旋涂系统中，实现软薄膜的厚度可控制造，无需专业工业设备。

Abstract: Spin coating is widely used for fabrication of thin polymer and elastomer films, yet reliable thickness verification of highly compliant materials remains challenging due to deformation from contact-based measurements and the cost and complexity of conventional optical metrology. Accurate thickness control is especially critical in soft elastomer applications such as dielectric elastomer actuators (DEAs), where mechanical and functional performance scales strongly with film thickness. This work presents a low-cost, primarily 3D-printed benchtop spin coater with an integrated, minimally deforming optical thickness measurement system for soft-film fabrication workflows. The system is designed to manufacture films between 50 and 300 microns thick with repeatability within 10 microns. Thickness is measured in-situ by tracking displacement of a reflected laser beam via quadrant photodetector, avoiding significant deformation. Optical geometry, sensor linearity constraints, and structural validation via finite element analysis are discussed. Experimental validation using calibrated metal shims demonstrated a thickness resolution of 3.6-3.7 microns and best-case measurement repeatability of 13 microns (95 percent confidence interval). The platform repeatably produced silicone films within 9 microns of target thickness, demonstrating that accessible optical metrology can be integrated into a low-cost spin coating system for practical, thickness-controlled fabrication of compliant thin films without specialized industrial instrumentation.

</details>


### [269] [DragMesh-2: Physically Plausible Dexterous Hand-Object Interaction with Articulated Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15133)
*Tianshan Zhang,Yijia Duan,Yanjun Li,Zeyu Zhang,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了DragMesh-2和PICA框架，用于灵巧手与关节物体的接触驱动交互，在接触负载变化下实现鲁棒操作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关节物体的灵巧交互面临挑战：目标部件无法直接驱动，运动必须通过持续接触产生；基于几何轨迹回放或开环执行无法建模接触动力学；固定动力学训练的策略在接触负载变化时会退化。

Method: 提出DragMesh-2接触驱动框架，将关节交互从物体中心生成扩展到手驱动的灵巧交互；提出PICA机制，在没有触觉/力反馈的情况下将物理信号注入策略学习。

Result: 在7个GAPartNet物体上，DragMesh-2在接触负载变化下比对比方法具有更强的鲁棒性，同时在多种阻尼条件下保持高任务成功率。

Conclusion: 接触驱动的灵巧交互框架结合物理信息注入的训练机制，可以有效提升关节物体操作在接触负载变化下的鲁棒性和任务成功率，无需依赖触觉或力反馈。

Abstract: Dexterous interaction with articulated objects is important for household, assistive, and humanoid manipulation, where multi-finger hands can provide compliant contact patterns beyond parallel-jaw grasping. However, articulated-object manipulation differs from static-object manipulation: the target part cannot be directly actuated, and its motion must emerge through sustained physical hand--handle contact. This makes the transition from object-centric articulated generation to hand-driven dexterous hand--object interaction non-trivial, since geometric trajectory replay or open-loop execution does not model the contact dynamics required to move the articulated part. Moreover, policies trained only for task completion under fixed dynamics can overfit nominal contact loads, especially without tactile or force feedback, and may degrade when the contact load changes. To address these challenges, we present DragMesh-2, a contact-driven framework for dexterous interaction with articulated objects that extends articulated interaction from object-centric generation to hand-driven dexterous hand--object interaction, where articulated motion must arise through physical contact. We further propose PICA, a physically informed contact-aware training mechanism that injects physical signals into policy learning without tactile or force feedback, improving robustness and task success under changing contact loads. Finally, we conduct systematic evaluation across multiple damping conditions and articulated-object categories to study robustness under contact-load variation, and provide a pure-geometry dexterous interaction resource to support future loco-manipulation and humanoid hand--object interaction research. Across seven GAPartNet objects, DragMesh-2 achieves stronger robustness under contact-load variation than the compared methods while maintaining high task success across damping conditions.

</details>


### [270] [MimicIK: Real-Time Generative Inverse Kinematics from Teleoperation with FK Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15148)
*Jiahao Yang,Shenhao Yan,Fan Feng,Chengsi Yao,Ge Wang,Zhixin Mai,Yiming Zhao,Yatong Han*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MimicIK提出了一种基于条件流匹配的实时生成式逆运动学框架，通过遥操作示教学习平滑鲁棒的关节空间运动先验，在保持高几何精度的同时实现实时控制（6.74ms推理延迟，20Hz控制频率），并有效解决了传统数值求解器在奇异点附近的不稳定分支切换问题和学习方法的精度-平滑度权衡困境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆运动学（IK）仍是实时机器人操作的关键瓶颈。经典数值求解器精度高但在闭环部署中常出现不连续分支切换和奇异点附近的不稳定行为；而学习式IK方法难以同时兼顾空间精度、运动平滑性和实时效率，特别是在训练数据来自含噪的人体遥操作示教时。现有方法无法同时满足这些需求。

Method: MimicIK采用条件流匹配（Conditional Flow Matching）框架，以当前关节构型和目标末端执行器位姿为条件，通过最小化迭代策略（MIP）骨干网络进行两步迭代精化过程预测连续delta关节指令。同时引入可微分正运动学正则化项（FK一致性损失），在训练中惩罚任务空间与目标位姿的偏差，从而强制执行物理一致性。

Result: 在包含8,848条遥操作示教的6-DOF真实机器人数据集上，MimicIK达到平均位置误差4.65mm，10mm成功率92.01%，轨迹尖峰率仅7.99%。相比UNet扩散基线，推理延迟从21.66ms降至6.74ms；相比确定性MLP基线，在分布外部署时保持稳定，支持20Hz实时控制。

Conclusion: MimicIK通过条件流匹配生成式框架有效整合了精度、平滑性和实时性，在奇异构型下表现稳健，为实际机器人实时操作提供了一种可行的IK解决方案。

Abstract: Inverse kinematics (IK) remains a critical bottleneck for real-time robot manipulation. Classical numerical solvers achieve high geometric precision but often suffer from discontinuous branch switching and unstable behavior near kinematic singularities during closed-loop deployment. Meanwhile, learned IK approaches frequently struggle to balance spatial accuracy, motion smoothness, and real-time efficiency, particularly when trained on noisy human teleoperation data. We present \textbf{MimicIK}, a real-time generative inverse kinematics framework that learns smooth and robust joint-space motion priors from teleoperation demonstrations through conditional flow matching. Given the current joint configuration and a target end-effector pose, MimicIK predicts continuous delta-joint commands using an efficient two-step iterative refinement process based on a Minimal Iterative Policy (MIP) backbone. To enforce physical consistency, we further introduce an FK consistency loss, a differentiable forward-kinematics regularization that penalizes task-space deviations from the target pose during training. We evaluate MimicIK on a real-world 6-DOF robot dataset containing 8,848 teleoperation demonstrations. MimicIK achieves a mean position error of 4.65 mm, a 10 mm success rate of 92.01\%, and a trajectory spike rate of only 7.99\%. Compared with a UNet diffusion baseline, our method improves both spatial accuracy and motion smoothness while reducing inference latency from 21.66 ms to 6.74 ms. Furthermore, unlike deterministic MLP baselines that catastrophically diverge under out-of-distribution deployment, MimicIK remains stable near singular configurations and enables robust 20 Hz real-time control on deployment hardware.

</details>


### [271] [Task-Aware Environment Augmentation for Reliable Navigation via Shielded Conditional Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15154)
*Bharawee Phoompho,Gokul Puthumanaillam,Yan Miao,Ruben Hernandez,Tim Bretl,Sayan Mitra,Melkior Ornik*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SCoDA方法，通过条件扩散模型学习如何在已知环境中放置有限数量的视觉标记，以增强机器人轨迹规划在部分可观测条件下的执行可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常通过调整机器人自身（如信念空间规划、主动定位）来应对部分可观测性，但在观测信息匮乏的区域表现脆弱且计算开销大。本文提出反向思路：通过增强环境本身（放置视觉标记）来提升轨迹执行可靠性，这是一个尚未充分探索的问题。

Method: 提出SCoDA（Shielded Conditional Diffusion for Environment Augmentation），利用条件扩散模型学习标记布局的条件分布，以环境地图、规划轨迹、扰动上下文和执行轮廓为条件。其屏蔽采样器推理轨迹中需要位姿校正的位置，引导分布朝向任务相关且预算有限的标记布局。

Result: 在模拟基准测试和硬件部署实验中，SCoDA在轨迹执行可靠性和完成时间上均显著优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 少量精心放置的标记在关键时刻提供有效观测，足以防止不确定性累积，从而提升部分可观测条件下的轨迹执行可靠性。环境增强是解决该问题的有效新范式。

Abstract: Reliable trajectory planning under partial observability depends not only on computing a feasible geometric path, but also on whether the robot receives informative observations while executing that trajectory. Existing approaches usually keep the environment fixed and adapt the robot through belief-space planning, active localization, or added sensing, often incurring costly uncertainty propagation and brittle behavior in observation-poor regions. We flip this perspective and address the largely open problem of \emph{task-aware environment augmentation}: given a mapped environment, a planned task trajectory, and a small budget of visual fiducial markers, where should the environment be augmented so that the planned trajectory can be executed reliably under uncertainty? Our key observation is that useful marker layouts are defined by the localization support they provide along the task trajectory: a small number of well-timed observations can be sufficient to prevent uncertainty from accumulating in regions where state-estimation error would otherwise compromise control. Building on this observation, we present \tbp{SCoDA}, $\textbf{S}$hielded $\textbf{Co}$nditional $\textbf{D}$iffusion for Environment $\textbf{A}$ugmentation. \tbp{SCoDA} learns a conditional distribution over high-performing fiducial layouts from data, using the environment, planned trajectory, disturbance context, and desired execution profile as conditioning. Its shielded sampler reasons over where along the planned execution pose corrections should occur, and steers this distribution toward task-relevant, finite-budget augmentations. Across simulated benchmarks and hardware deployments, we show that \tbp{SCoDA} improves trajectory execution reliability and completion time over strong baselines.
  Code, models and dataset available at: \hyperlink{scoda-diffusion.github.io}{https://scoda-diffusion.github.io/}

</details>


### [272] [Seam-to-Graph Reconstruction for Garment Configuration Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15171)
*Xuzhao Huang,Kai Tang,Fuyuki Tokuda,Norman C. Tien,Kazuhiro Kosuge*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Seam-to-Graph网络，利用图神经网络和注意力机制将部分观测的接缝信息映射为拓扑编码的结构骨架图，用于实时服装状态估计，并设计变形感知的分层视觉伺服控制器，在双机器人系统上实现高精度服装配置对齐，达到人类水平且更具鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 服装的接缝包含丰富的结构信息，但在机器人操作场景中经常只能部分观测到。如何鲁棒地利用这些不完整的接缝信息进行服装状态估计和精准操控是核心动因。

Method: 提出Seam-to-Graph网络（基于图神经网络和注意力机制），将非结构化接缝观测映射为拓扑编码的结构骨架图；基于骨架图状态估计，设计变形感知的分层视觉伺服控制器，实现服装配置对齐。

Result: 在双机器人系统上将服装装载到丝网印刷台并精确对齐。实验表明：该方法达到人类水平的对齐精度，且误差方差更小，对不同服装具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 证明了利用接缝信息进行服装操作是有效的，所提方法在精度和鲁棒性上均表现优异。

Abstract: Seams encode rich structural information about garments but are frequently partially observable in robotic manipulation scenarios. To robustly leverage seam information, we propose a Seam-to-Graph network based on graph neural networks and attention mechanisms. This network maps unstructured seam observations to a topology-encoded structural skeleton graph for real-time garment state estimation. Using this skeleton-graph-based state estimation, we design a deformation-aware, hierarchical visual servoing controller for garment configuration alignment. We implement this controller on a bimanual robot system to load a garment onto a screen printing platen and to align it to the desired configuration precisely. Real-robot experiments demonstrate that the robot using the proposed method not only achieves human-level alignment accuracy with reduced variance in alignment error but is also robust to different garments. These results demonstrate that the use of seam information is effective for garment manipulation.

</details>


### [273] [Rethinking Implicit Spatial Representation in Visuomotor Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15232)
*Xiangyu Chen,Yuxuan Hu,Chuhao Zhou,Jianfei Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究了生成式模仿学习中的空间softmax池化机制，发现其能产生紧凑稳定的空间表征，但存在表征瓶颈（下采样削弱细粒度信息）。为此提出PRISM视觉编码器，通过自上而下的交叉注意力融合多尺度空间信息，在低分辨率高精度任务上显著提升性能（如ToolHang任务从5.0%提升至13.4%），且参数量仅增加15.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作虽然采用了空间softmax池化，但其有效性和内在机制尚未被充分理解。本文旨在重新审视这一操作，探究隐式空间表征是否为机器人操作提供有效且稳定的视觉特征，并揭示其局限性。

Method: 通过系统性对比不同池化方法，发现空间softmax池化优于特征值表征。进一步通过显著性分析揭示其关注任务相关区域的特性。基于表征瓶颈的发现，提出PRISM视觉编码器，利用自上而下的交叉注意力融合多尺度隐式空间信息。

Result: PRISM在多个任务和策略骨干上取得一致改进。在低分辨率高精度的ToolHang任务中，平均成功率从5.0%提升至13.4%，参数量仅增加15.4%。

Conclusion: 多尺度隐式空间表征是机器人操作中有效且高效的设计原则，PRISM验证了这一思路的实用性。

Abstract: Generative model-based imitation learning has become a widely adopted paradigm for robotic manipulation, where policy performance depends critically on the conditioned visual representations. Although spatial softmax-based representations have been adopted in prior visuomotor policies, their effectiveness and underlying mechanisms remain insufficiently understood. This work rethinks the use of spatial softmax pooling: do such implicit spatial representations provide effective and stable visual features for robotic manipulation? Through systematic studies of different pooling methods in visual encoders, we find that this pooling operation produces compact and stable spatial representations, which outperform feature-value representations, despite using substantially fewer dimensions. Complementary saliency analysis further suggests that these spatial representations guide the encoder to focus more consistently on task-relevant regions. However, this advantage is limited by a representation bottleneck in current visual encoders: repeated downsampling operations weaken fine-grained spatial information before the action-generation module can use it, especially under low-resolution observations. Motivated by these findings, we propose PRISM, a visual encoder that preserves multiscale implicit spatial information through top-down cross-attention fusion. Experiments across multiple tasks and policy backbones show consistent improvements. In particular, on the low-resolution, high-precision ToolHang task, PRISM shows clear gains, improving the average success rate from 5.0% to 13.4% while increasing parameters by only 15.4%. These results support the use of multiscale implicit spatial representations as an effective and efficient design principle for robotic manipulation.

</details>


### [274] [Co-Creating Buildable and Open Social Robot Study Companions with University Students](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15239)
*Farnaz Baksh,Matevž B. Zorec,Feiazie Baksh,Karl Kruusamäe*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 通过Design for Assembly/Disassembly方法重新设计开源社交机器人底盘，使系统可用性从差提升至优秀（SUS 59.4→89.4），组装时间缩短，且发现感知工作负荷（而非完成时间）是学生采用开源硬件的关键因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开源社交机器人虽然具有可访问性、可修复性和学生赋权等优势，但机器人组装本身往往构成障碍。现有平台要么预组装好了（失去动手学习机会），要么使用不熟悉的紧固件、混乱的布线和难以触及的维修点，降低了学生参与度。能否通过有针对性的机械重新设计来降低这一障碍同时保持结构完整性，尚待验证。

Method: 采用双钻设计框架（Double Diamond），与圭亚那和爱沙尼亚的大学生共创Robot Study Companion (RSC) v4.1：映射痛点，然后围绕扭转锁扣件、卡扣接头和免工具维修锁扣重新设计底盘。通过两项研究（开发者与首次组装者），使用SUS、NASA-TLX和组装时间进行定量评估。

Result: 系统可用性从Poor提升至Excellent（SUS 59.4→89.4），感知工作负荷呈下降趋势（NASA-TLX 4.29→4.00），平均组装时间呈下降趋势（21.4→13.7分钟，包含初级组装者的学习效应）。定向提示和导航连续性成为面向首次组装者的下一个文档化重点。

Conclusion: DfA/DfD干预在缩短组装时间之前就已重塑了组装体验。感知工作负荷（而非完成时间）是决定学生是否采用开源硬件的关键因素。

Abstract: Open-source social robots offer accessibility, repairability, and student empowerment, yet the build itself often presents a barrier. Existing platforms either ship pre-assembled, foreclosing hands-on learning, or expose students to unfamiliar fasteners, opaque wiring, and inaccessible service points that erode engagement. Whether targeted mechanical redesign can lower this barrier whilst maintaining structural integrity remains untested. Here we show that Design for Assembly (DfA) and Design for Disassembly (DfD) interventions reshape how a build feels before they shorten how long it takes. Working with university students in Guyana and Estonia, we applied the Double Diamond framework to co-create the Robot Study Companion (RSC) v4.1: mapping pain points, then redesigning its chassis around twist-lock fasteners, snap-fit joints, and tool-free service latches. Across two studies with developers and first-time builders, system usability climbed from Poor to Excellent (SUS 59.4 to 89.4), perceived workload trended downward (NASA-TLX 4.29 to 4.00), and mean assembly time trended downward (21.4 to 13.7 minutes, with juniors' learning effect), whilst orientation cues and navigation continuity for first-time builders emerged as the next documentation frontier. Perceived workload, not completion time, appears to govern whether students take up open hardware.

</details>


### [275] [Driving, Fast or Slow? Neuro-Symbolic Guidance for Motion Prediction in Multi-Modal Ground Mobility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15251)
*Simon Kohaut,Felix Divo,Julius Hahnewald,Benedict Flade,Julian Eggert,Kristian Kersting,Devendra Singh Dhami*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了TraCS，一种神经符号框架，通过概率性一阶逻辑增强现有黑盒运动预测模型，利用智能体代码生成桥接交通法规与运动预测，并通过反应式数据流推理引擎和神经置信度评分实现可解释、高效且鲁棒的合规预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有交通场景运动预测方法多为黑盒模型，缺乏对真实世界中交通规则和行为约束的显式编码，导致预测结果不准确且缺乏可解释性。

Method: 提出TraCS框架：1) 智能体代码生成管线，将自然语言交通法规转化为概率性一阶逻辑；2) 反应式数据流推理引擎，动态维护和更新合规性景观；3) 神经置信度评分，自适应衰减合规信号以防止过度修正。

Result: 在Argoverse 2基准测试上，TraCS一致地提升了最先进运动预测骨干网络的性能，验证了概率性符号合规推理作为纯神经预测的有效补充。

Conclusion: 概率性和符号化的合规推理是一种广泛适用且计算高效的辅助手段，能够显著提升纯神经运动预测模型的表现。

Abstract: Accurate and interpretable motion prediction for heterogeneous traffic spaces, including pedestrians, bicycles, cars, and trucks, is essential for safe autonomous navigation. Nevertheless, state-of-the-art approaches remain predominantly black-box, lacking explicit encoding of the regulatory and behavioral constraints of real-world mobility. We propose Trajectory Compliance-Shaping (TraCS), a neuro-symbolic framework that augments existing black-box motion prediction backbones with interpretable and probabilistic first-order logic. To do so, TraCS employs an agentic code-generation pipeline to bridge the gap between natural-language descriptions of traffic regulations and probabilistic motion prediction. Furthermore, TraCS employs a reactive data-streaming inference engine that maintains and efficiently updates compliance landscapes as scenes evolve. To prevent TraCS from overconfidently steering the backbone's predictions in the wrong direction, we propose a neural confidence rating learned as a context-aware attenuation of the compliance signal. We demonstrate on the Argoverse 2 benchmark how TraCS consistently improves state-of-the-art prediction backbones, showing that probabilistic and symbolic compliance reasoning is a broadly applicable and computationally efficient complement to purely neural motion predictors.

</details>


### [276] [OSDAG: Online Scheduling for Efficient Multi-Robot Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15255)
*Thanh Nguyen Canh,Thang Tran Viet,Phuc Van Dinh,Xiem HoangVan,Nak Young Chong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出OSDAG框架，通过一次性LLM推理将自然语言任务分解为DAG图，并结合在线调度器实时分配任务给空闲机器人，实现了5-15倍推理加速和最高38%的完工时间缩减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的多机器人协调方法存在两个瓶颈：(1)执行过程中重复调用LLM推理导致延迟随机器人数量增加而剧增；(2)离线预提交调度导致机器人空闲等待，无法充分利用并行机会。亟需一种既能保持高层推理能力又能实现高效低层调度的方法。

Method: OSDAG框架包含两个核心组件：(1)LLM一次性将自然语言指令分解为带有依赖注释的DAG任务图，编码前序约束和资源约束；(2)轻量级在线调度器实时将就绪任务分配给空闲机器人，暴露所有可并行执行的任务。

Result: 在五个基准场景中：(1)推理速度比基于对话的方法快5-15倍；(2)完工时间比顺序基线降低最高38%；(3)保持有竞争力的成功率。仿真和双臂操作真实实验均验证了有效性。

Conclusion: OSDAG通过"一次性LLM推理+DAG表示+在线调度"的创新组合，有效解决了多机器人协调中推理延迟和调度空闲两大问题，兼顾了推理的灵活性和执行的效率。

Abstract: Coordinating heterogeneous multi-robot systems (MRS) for complex, long-horizon tasks requires both flexible high-level reasoning and efficient low-level scheduling. Existing LLM-based approaches address the reasoning side but introduce two critical bottlenecks: (1) repeated LLM inference during execution, which inflates latency with agent count, and (2) offline, pre-committed scheduling, which forces robots to idle while waiting for sequentially ordered predecessors even when independent work is available. This paper presents OSDAG, a novel framework that integrates LLM-based task reasoning with Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) representation and constraint-aware online scheduling. The LLM is invoked once to decompose a natural-language instruction into a dependency-annotated task graph, and a lightweight online scheduler then allocates ready tasks to idle agents in real time. The DAG representation encodes both precedence and resource constraints, ensuring correctness while exposing all available parallelism. Experiments across five benchmark scenarios demonstrate that OSDAG achieves 5-15x faster reasoning time compared to dialogue-based methods, reduces makespan by up to 38% over sequential baselines, and maintains competitive success rates. Both simulation and real-world experiments on dual-arm manipulation tasks validate the effectiveness and practicality of the proposed approach for efficient multi-robot coordination. The website and resources are available at http://thanhnguyencanh.github.io/LLM_DAG4MultiRobot

</details>


### [277] [Acting While Understanding: Asynchronous Semantic-Action Decoupling for Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15285)
*Shenhao Yan,Ge Wang,Qi Liu,Weilin Meng,Jiahao Yang,Chengsi Yao,Fan Feng,Xiaoguang Ma,Yiming Zhao,Yatong Han*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出异步语义-动作解耦框架，将VLA模型拆分为低频语义理解模块和高频动作生成模块，实现高达35.6Hz的闭环控制频率，无需完整运行VLA推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型虽在机器人操作中表现优异，但全模型推理计算成本高，限制了其在低延迟、高频率闭环控制中的部署。

Method: 提出异步语义-动作解耦框架：1) 低频语义理解模块异步更新可复用的语义条件；2) 高频动作模块持续输出控制动作；3) 引入历史动作条件化与时间错位训练，缓解陈旧语义与当前执行状态之间的时间不匹配问题。

Result: 在LIBERO上基于π₀.₅和UniVLA的实验以及UniVLA的真实机器人部署中，服务端动作模块推理吞吐量达35.6Hz，实现了高频闭环控制。

Conclusion: 该框架为VLA模型提供了一条低侵入性的路径，使其无需以控制速率运行完整推理即可实现高频闭环控制。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have demonstrated strong task understanding and generalization in robotic manipulation, yet the high computational cost of full-model inference limits their deployment in low-latency, high-frequency closed-loop control. We propose an asynchronous semantic-action decoupling framework that separates semantic understanding from action generation along the internal semantic-action interface of existing VLAs, without redesigning the vision-language backbone or introducing an external planner. A low-frequency understanding module asynchronously updates reusable semantic conditions, while a high-frequency action module continuously outputs control actions without repeatedly invoking the full model. To mitigate the temporal mismatch between stale semantics and the current execution state, we further introduce historical action conditioning and time-misalignment training, which provide short-horizon execution context and improve feedback control robustness under stale semantic conditions. Experiments on LIBERO with $π_{0.5}$ and UniVLA, together with real-robot deployment using UniVLA, show that the proposed framework achieves up to 35.6 Hz server-side action-module inference throughput and offers a low-intrusion path to high-frequency closed-loop control without running full VLA inference at control rate.

</details>


### [278] [Covariance-Regulated Recursive Koopman Learning for Nonlinear Systems with Uncertain Time-Varying Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15317)
*Weibin Gu,Chen Yang,Lu Shi,Chao Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种协方差调控的递归Koopman学习框架（CR-RKL），通过误差死区门控和常数迹归一化两种互补策略，解决了在线递归Koopman估计中协方差爆炸和参数冻结的数值不稳定性问题，并在非完整约束轮式机器人和仿生扑翼飞行器上验证了其鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线训练的自主机器人模型在时变动力学场景下泛化能力差；Koopman算子虽能线性化非线性动力学，但其在线递归估计存在低激励下的协方差风爆（遗忘因子导致）和无遗忘时的增益消失等数值脆弱性问题。

Method: 提出CR-RKL框架，包含两种互补策略：1）误差死区门控（error dead-zone gating），在误差过小时停止更新以防止协方差爆炸；2）常数迹归一化（constant-trace normalization），保持协方差矩阵迹恒定，在避免参数冻结的同时保留不确定性的几何结构。

Result: 在两种平台上验证：1）存在车轮打滑和Stribeck摩擦的非完整约束差分驱动轮式机器人；2）26克仿生扑翼微型飞行器。CR-RKL实现了数值稳定且精确的在线建模，嵌入模型预测控制后能在不确定时变动力学下保持可靠的跟踪性能。

Conclusion: CR-RKL有效解决了递归Koopman学习的数值不稳定问题，两种策略均可独立防止协方差爆炸和参数冻结，其中常数迹归一化还能保留不确定性几何结构，适用于对数值鲁棒性要求高的实时机器人控制场景。

Abstract: Offline models for autonomous robots often fail under time-varying dynamics outside their training distribution. Koopman operator theory offers a linear representation of nonlinear dynamics via lifting, but its transition to real-time recursive estimation may suffer numerical vulnerabilities: covariance windup under low excitation when using exponential forgetting, and vanishing gain without forgetting. This paper introduces a Covariance-Regulated Recursive Koopman Learning (CR-RKL) framework with two complementary strategies--error dead-zone gating and constant-trace normalization--each independently capable of preventing covariance explosion and parameter freezing, with the latter additionally preserving the geometric structure of uncertainty. Validated on a non-holonomic differential-drive robot with wheel slip and Stribeck friction and on a 26-gram butterfly-inspired flapping-wing micro aerial vehicle, CR-RKL achieves numerically stable and accurate online modeling, and when embedded in model predictive control, it maintains reliable tracking performance under uncertain, time-varying dynamics.

</details>


### [279] [SimWeaver: Zero-Shot RGB Sim-to-Real for Deformable Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15338)
*Wenkang Hu,Haoran Wang,Yitong Li,Liu Liu,Mengao Zhao,Lai Jiang,Xincheng Tang,Junhang Wei,Zhengjie Shu,Zhendong Wang,Zhizhong Su,Huamin Wang,Ruigang Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SimWeaver提出了一种仅使用200条模拟演示即可零样本训练RGB VLA策略的方法，在5种可变形操作任务（包括塑料袋操作）上实现了80%以上（平均91%）的真实世界成功率，无需遥操作或逐任务标定。该方法结合了可靠模拟器、可扩展资产框架、拓扑感知轨迹合成器和ISP感知光度增强的模拟到真实协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可变形物体的RGB仿真到真实迁移（sim-to-real）在缺乏真实世界微调的情况下仍未得到解决，现有方法需要大量真实数据或遥操作，成本高昂。

Method: SimWeaver包含四个组件：1) SimWeaver-Sim：基于测量数据的可靠模拟器；2) SimWeaver-Asset：支持单图像生成的可扩展资产框架；3) SimWeaver-Syn：确定性拓扑感知轨迹合成器；4) SimWeaver-Real：具有ISP感知光度增强的模拟到真实协议。

Result: 每个任务仅需200条模拟演示，在5种可变形操作任务上达到80%以上成功率，平均91%。在丝绸抓取任务中，面对视觉分布偏移时达到100%成功率，而真实数据基线下降至9-70%，且每条轨迹成本低两个数量级。

Conclusion: SimWeaver证明了通过精心设计的模拟环境和数据增强，无需真实世界微调即可实现可变形物体的零样本RGB策略学习，显著降低了数据获取成本。

Abstract: RGB sim-to-real for deformable manipulation has remained largely unsolved without real-world fine-tuning. We present SimWeaver, which trains zero-shot RGB VLA policies on 200 simulated demonstrations per task, reaching above 80% per-task and 91% average real-world success across 5 diverse deformable tasks including plastic-bag manipulation, without teleoperation or per-task calibration. SimWeaver combines a reliable measurement-backed simulator (SimWeaver-Sim) with an extensible asset framework supporting single-image generation(SimWeaver-Asset), a deterministic topology-aware trajectory synthesizer (SimWeaver-Syn), and a sim-to-real protocol with ISP-aware photometric augmentation (SimWeaver-Real). On silk grasping, the sim-trained policy reaches 100% under visual distribution shifts where real-data baselines drop to 9-70%, at two orders of magnitude lower per-trajectory cost. We will release SimWeaver and a representative asset subset. Project page: https://simweaver.github.io/

</details>


### [280] [A Hybrid Model-Based and Model-Free Framework for Active Multi-View Viewpoint Optimization in Sonar Target Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15373)
*Yongkyoon Park,Jane Shin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合模型驱动与数据驱动的主动多视角目标识别框架，用于前视声纳。使用CNN提供观测似然，Radon变换估计朝向，PPO学习视角选择策略，在降低感知步数和运动成本的同时取得有竞争力的识别准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统主动目标识别方法依赖模型驱动的POMDP在线树搜索，计算开销大；而纯数据驱动方法缺乏视角感知能力。本文旨在结合两者优势，实现高效、低成本的主动多视角识别。

Method: 1) CNN提供数据驱动的观测似然；2) 基于Radon变换的朝向估计实现视角感知（无需角度标注）；3) 训练阶段使用信息增益奖励指导PPO智能体学习信念感知的视角选择策略；4) 部署时仅需CNN信念更新即可实时选择视角，无需在线POMDP树搜索。

Result: 在海洋垃圾前视声纳数据集上，所提方法在识别准确率上达到与模型驱动基线相当的水平，同时显著减少了感知步数和运动成本。

Conclusion: 提出的混合框架有效平衡了识别精度与计算效率，通过离线学习视角选择策略避免了在线POMDP搜索的高计算代价，适用于实时声纳目标识别任务。

Abstract: This paper presents a hybrid model-based and model-free framework for active multi-view target recognition using forward-looking sonar. A convolutional neural network (CNN) provides data-driven observation likelihoods, while Radon-based orientation estimation enables viewpoint-aware sensing without requiring angle annotations. During training, an information-gain-based reward guides a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent to learn a belief-aware viewpoint selection policy offline.
